creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Allow users to specify an optional ANSI 16 fallback color when defining RGB colors. This addresses terminals that don't support 24-bit true color (notably macOS Terminal.app, some remote sessions).

## Behavior
- Fallback is optional—if not specified, RGB simply won't render on unsupported terminals
- Detection via COLORTERM env var: if set to 'truecolor' or '24bit', use RGB; otherwise use fallback
- Keep it simple: just ANSI 16 fallback, no 256-color intermediate tier

## API Ideas
- `RGBWithFallback(r, g, b, fallback Attribute)`
- Or chainable: `RGB(r, g, b).Fallback(FgRed)`
- Similar for background: `BgRGBWithFallback` or `BgRGB().Fallback()`

## Rationale
Explicit fallback > automatic nearest-color mapping because:
- Semantic meaning matters more than perceptual similarity (error red should fall back to FgRed, not whatever algorithm picks)
- Predictable behavior—users know exactly what they'll get
- Simpler implementation (no color-distance algorithms)
title: Add ANSI fallback support for RGB colors
